assets.name: duel
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production candidate illustration for a Gauntlet Online game-menu choice, not a screenshot. Visual direction: modern tactical card-game arena infrastructure, blackened steel, graphite composite, bone enamel, restrained worn brass details and small amber and teal signal lights. Premium painted game concept art, clear tangible materials, readable silhouettes, controlled contrast. Landscape 3:2 composition with the main subject centered and all critical details in the middle 60 percent so both square thumbnails and wide menu crops work. Moderately bright, readable art; the application will place text separately. No people, faces, faction or civilization references, fantasy castles, medieval ornament, ornate gold, casino chips, currency, readable text, numbers, logos, labels, UI, watermarks, or face-up card ranks. Avoid a generic empty corridor. This is noncanonical interface illustration only; do not invent named lore or game mechanics. Subject: a close three-quarter view of a compact competitive duel station. Two opposing racks of plain charcoal-backed playing cards face one another across a clean brushed-steel playing surface. A restrained amber readiness light on one side and teal on the other suggest two opponents ready to play. Strong diagonal composition, immediately recognizable as a two-player card confrontation. Architectural background soft and secondary; no tabletop clutter.
